summary: Early-career Civil Engineering professional currently working as a Graduate Engineer Trainee in Project Management at McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited. Experience includes EPC site progress monitoring, quantity estimation, BOQ/BBS preparation, vendor payment and PO tracking, progress reporting, QA/QC and HSE exposure, plus BIM training and industrial site internships. Targeting junior Construction Engineer, Site Engineer, Planning Engineer, Quantity Surveyor/Estimator and BIM support roles.

experience.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee – Project Management
details: Monitor daily site progress and coordinate project teams on EPC and industrial infrastructure work.
Estimate quantities for cement, brickwork, plaster and reinforcement from construction drawings.
Maintain Excel progress reports, contract payment status, PO documentation and project records.
Prepare BBS and material quantity sheets; follow up on procurement, planning, approvals and quality clearances.

experience.title: BIM Intern
details: Completed 90 hours of Autodesk Revit BIM training.
Converted 2D AutoCAD drawings into coordinated 3D models and created architectural models, Revit families and rendered views.
